entities.name: Anniara Muñoz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anniara Muñoz Carrazana is a Cuban volleyball player who competed with the Cuba women's national volleyball team at the 2004 Summer Olympics winning the bronze medal. She also competed at the 2002 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Championship in Germany. On club level she played with Cienfuegos.
